You'll experience almost the entire soba-making process — from preparing the dough, kneading, stretching, to cutting — and enjoy the soba noodles you've made yourself for lunch, served with local vegetable tempura.

【Fee】Adults ¥4,000 | Elementary school children ¥3,000 | Preschoolers ¥1,500 (includes guide, insurance, lunch)

【Capacity】2 groups (up to 4 people per group)

【Guide】Taira Kurien staff

【What to bring】Drinks, apron, head scarf, towel, mask

【More info】Taira Kurien website: https://tairakurien.com/
location: 集合 たいら栗園（西武池袋線「東吾野駅」下車徒歩15分）
summary: Experience making soba noodles — savor the satoyama (rural village landscape) with all five senses
